title: Mail Volume Collapsed To 109 Billion Pieces
hook: Mail volume collapsed to 109 billion pieces.
closing: Fewer letters spread postal costs across fewer customers, keeping postage pressure high.
question: What do you still mail?

segments.say: Total mail fell to 109 billion pieces, leaving the postal network with nearly half its former traffic.
First-Class Mail fell to 46 billion pieces, showing personal and business letters disappeared fastest.
A stamp reached 68 cents, so shrinking volume did not make sending a letter cheaper.
